ACTION=A2
Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 30 kph (8.3 m/s) and approaching a slower lead vehicle moving at 3.6 m/s ahead in the same lane ($x = 20.5$ m). Since the ego is closing in on the lead vehicle at a significant speed differential, a deceleration action (such as braking, A2) is required to maintain a safe following distance.
